create_rate_limiter: create a RateLimiter instance for an LLM provider with per-minute request and token limits
wait_if_needed: wait before making an LLM API call if rate limits for requests or tokens are approaching
record_request: record an LLM API request with its input and output token counts and calculate cost
print_usage_stats: print total usage statistics including requests, tokens, and cumulative cost for an LLM provider
clean_old_entries: remove entries older than one minute from a sliding window usage queue
